articles.summary: ROCKVILLE, Md. , Nov. 14, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Capital Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: CBNK) today announced the appointment of Jacob Dalaya as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Capital Bancorp and Capital Bank , National Association, effective immediately.
